$description: Whimbrel design tokens, direction Thread. The one design-time source: build.mjs turns this into CSS variables (Windows UI), Swift constants (Mac) and palette files in the themes/ schema. Values use the W3C Design Tokens shape ($value, $type) so another tool can read the file later.

palette.$description: The 15 skinnable color tokens (the keys of themes/*.json). A user's skin can replace these, so components must stay readable on any palette that passes the contrast guard.

fixed.$description: Colors a skin cannot change, because they carry meaning: the recording state, text Whimbrel wrote, the focus ring, and the app dots on the timeline. Order of values: light, dark, high contrast light, high contrast dark.

recording.$description: Recording state fill and text. Never used for anything else.

onRecording.$description: Text and glyphs on a recording fill.

recordingTint.$description: Quiet background behind a recording line.

aiInk.$description: Text Whimbrel wrote, and its source marks.

aiTint.$description: Background of a selected AI line and its source.

paused.$description: Paused state. Always shown with a pause glyph and the word.

scrim.$description: Shadow and overlay color; components apply their own opacity.

radius.$description: Per OS: macOS uses larger, concentric corners; Windows 11 uses 4 px for controls and 8 px for surfaces.

type.$description: Roles, not sizes. size/lineHeight in pt on macOS and px at 100% on Windows (emitted as rem so Windows text scaling applies). weight is a CSS weight. Body faces: SF Pro on macOS, Segoe UI Variable on Windows. The reading role is the serif used for notes and answers.

win.ui: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

elevation.$description: Shadow per level: y offset, blur, opacity of fixed.scrim. Level 0 is flat. Dark and high contrast use a border instead of relying on the shadow.

motion.$description: Durations in ms. Windows values follow Fluent (167, 250, 333). With Reduce Motion every duration is 0 and movement becomes a fade.

size.$description: Minimum hit target per OS, and fixed layout widths.
